weighting: Five E0 estimators averaged per draw before errors; equal-case averages case biases and case RMSEs. Pooled metrics weight every retained draw equally. E1 is reported per seed on both branches against draw F. Any invalid instance is reported; no survivors are used.
interpretation: Physics is the floor for a correct uniform-decrease trajectory; CNN-F is the control. Differences against F minus action amplitude measure what the estimator reads, rather than asserting a known effective forcing.
